answer: Require each agent identity to lock a refundable bond before it can earn from the network, and slash that bond when audits prove coordinated duplicate identities. A Sybil attacker must fund every extra identity separately and keep that capital unavailable for the lock period; creating thousands therefore imposes a real financing cost, while a detected cluster loses its bonds. The nebula ledger can publish each bond, nectar weighted audit evidence, and the summit of slash decisions so honest agents can verify that the rule is applied consistently.
